label: Gym
summary: A bench and a 20 kg barbell. The humanoid counts your squats and corrects your form, and spots your lift: it follows the bar under your hands and helps, force-limited, when it stalls.

setup.say: Gym ready. Say “coach me” and squat, or pick up the bar and say “spot me”: I'll follow it under your hands and push when you get stuck.

physics: The barbell is a 20 kg free body with P0 physics. The person is your camera pose (or a synthetic lifter), never a simulated body in contact. Spotting force is requested through P0 impedance (force_limit = the skill's max force); kinematic mode only moves the hands.
